rule: Single-family house · 1.5+ baths · under $1.5M · Highland Park, Atwater Village, Frogtown, Eagle Rock, Mt. Washington, Glassell Park, Silver Lake, Echo Park, Los Feliz

finds.verifiedHow: Listing page opened directly (Coldwell Banker, MLS #26856717)
finds.why: The Instagram house. Guest apartment with its own entrance + full bath, renovated kitchen (sage cabinets, butcher block), shaded patio, producing avocado tree. 12-minute walk to Hermosillo. Two months on market in a hot neighborhood = real negotiating room.
finds.ask: Why has it sat ~59 days? Is the guest apartment permitted as habitable space? Any offers so far? Plan a sewer scope.

finds.verifiedHow: Redfin listing data confirmed same day
finds.why: On N Dillon itself. 1912 single-family on a 6,000 sqft lot. Sat 115 days and already cut to $1.499M — squeaks under the $1.5M cap with obvious room below ask.
finds.ask: Why the long sit? What did the last price cut respond to?

finds.verifiedHow: Live on Compass's Frogtown inventory the day of publishing
finds.why: A 2-bath house in Frogtown for $549K — the cheapest qualifying find on the entire board. Small (701 sqft), but at $783/sqft in a neighborhood with ~20 active listings total.
finds.ask: Small-lot home or standard fee-simple parcel? HOA or shared-drive arrangements? Confirm it's a detached house.

finds.verifiedHow: Live on Compass's Frogtown inventory the day of publishing
finds.why: 2bd/3ba, 1,000 sqft at $665K. The ½ address suggests a small-lot / rear home — worth confirming what you'd own.
finds.ask: Fee-simple small-lot or TIC? Shared walls or fully detached?

finds.verifiedHow: Live on Compass's Frogtown inventory the day of publishing
finds.why: 2bd/3ba, 1,034 sqft at $695K, blocks from the LA River path. Same caveat as the other ½ address: confirm the ownership structure.

finds.verifiedHow: Live on Compass's Frogtown inventory the day of publishing
finds.why: The big-family option: 4bd/3ba, 2,235 sqft at $604/sqft — cheap per foot for the neighborhood, and comfortably under the $1.5M cap.

corrections.text: 3041 Atwater Ave was emailed as a $999K active listing — WRONG. It SOLD in March 2026 for $1,230,000. It came from a stale search snippet and was not verified before sending. Retracted.
5314 Buchanan St (Highland Park) and 4511 Brunswick Ave (Atwater) — no active listing could be verified for either. Both retracted.
The 'Frogtown probate, two houses one lot, $995K' (2232 Meadowvale Ave) could not be confirmed on live inventory. Treated as gone until verified.
